I don't know how people fall for these lame ass scams. You get tricked by someone ready off a shitty canned script that can barely speak English. Not telling the teller and keeping it a secret but trusting the person who has an Indian accent on the phone than the bank employee. And you have to be the one involved in this investigation.  So the bank doesn't trust their own employees but they trust you a random person who think they might have an account compromised but yet you still someone have money in your bank to take out.  You are going to trust someone with an Indian accent over a phone line that you can't even see their face and where they are calling from over an actual branch employee. Damn people have become so naive these days. Plus people told you about these scams for years yet you still fall for it? It's not like you weren't aware of these scams. It is people have lost any reasoning skills and just take directions like sheep without any questioning anymore. Makes absolutely no sense at all. If you were  a victim of a scam you wouldn't still have funds in your account. Also your funds are all there and nothing is missing. Now it will be missing once you send it to the scammers. 

Unbelievable people fall for this crap. People have lost all common sense now that their brains are all sucked into a smartphone. How does taking money out and sending that money to a random account that isn't even yours going to protect you?  If you were really scared someone is going to take your money just take the money out and put it into another bank of your own or just keep the cash until you can open a new bank account that isn't compromised to keep the money safe there. But at a bank account of your own choosing not a link or account number the person tells you to send it to. Your bank will never ever tell you to take money out. They will just close your old account number and give you a new account number and tell you to change your password. Also why worry about your money as it is all protected for any fraud or scam or any unauthorized activities.  By taking that money out you willingly took it out you are no longer protected due to your actions so those funds will be gone forever.
